lines.text: 回去时，活动还没结束。有个新朋友问我是不是下次也来。我没有马上说一定会唱得更好，只说想再试一次，也问他平时怎么练。他说自己第一次更紧张，拿着话筒还忘了音乐已经开始。听见这个，我终于笑了，不是因为他的失误好笑，而是觉得自己不那么孤单了。

lines.en: The event was still going when we returned. A new friend asked whether I’d come next time. I said I’d like another try and asked how he practised. He said he’d been even more nervous his first time, forgetting the music had started while holding the microphone. I finally laughed—not at his mistake, but because I felt less alone.

lines.en: At home I circled the spot in the second line that needed practice and saved my new friend's contact details. He'd already messaged: next time, sing before asking if anyone could hear me. lines.en: Lin An still pictured a friend. To her, the mirror was where the person left behind finally saw themselves. I'd thought only of my earlier self; her explanation made me look back at the footsteps outside. We reread those lines. She pointed to the unfinished words under the window: if I addressed only myself, how would I sing this? I couldn't answer immediately, so I asked to hear her version. At that line she paused for half a beat, as though waiting for someone outside to speak.

lines.en: I suggested reading first so the two performers could hear a passage before playing. They had to leave after eight, so I proposed a short reading with enough time left for music. He'd contact them and message before Thursday's dinner. I changed my two blocks to three slots while waiting for their reply.

lines.en: People were talking at the stop and the event was ending at the other end of the call. I texted that I'd arrive late and kept waiting. Asked how long, I looked up twice before the bus finally arrived; only then did I estimate about ten minutes. lines.en: Over water I said the ending wasn't bad; I hadn't understood it. Which line hadn't I heard? My friend asked. He thought he'd missed that short section. I recounted what I remembered and asked about the earlier letter-writing scene. That was the part I couldn't recall, so we spread the programme on the table and checked the names together.

lines.en: After getting home I asked him to write out the shop name and time next time, instead of just sending “red door.” He replied with a deliberately slow voice message and repeated the name three times. We agreed to text important changes but keep joking on the phone as usual. Before bed he sent tomorrow's shop name and time. I replied yes, this time reading the address too before putting my phone down.

lines.text: 九点半以后，我们把设备关好。读书的人收纸，工作人员卷线，我把乐器装回盒子。有人走过来说再唱一分钟吧，我指着已经拔掉的线，说唱以前还得重新接线、调音，唱完又要收一遍。他看看空下来的桌子，说那算了，帮我把椅子搬过去。我在门口轻轻哼了一句，林安把最后一行接上，大家笑了。刚才还想再唱的人也跟着哼，没有回去开设备。工作人员拿来最后一把椅子，问我们明天是不是还起得来，我们马上把门让开，一边笑一边往外走。
lines.py: jiǔ diǎn bàn yǐ hòu , wǒ men bǎ shè bèi guān hǎo . dú shū de rén shōu zhǐ , gōng zuò rén yuán juǎn xiàn , wǒ bǎ yuè qì zhuāng huí hé zi . yǒu rén zǒu guò lái shuō zài chàng yī fēn zhōng ba , wǒ zhǐ zhe yǐ jīng bá diào de xiàn , shuō chàng yǐ qián hái děi chóng xīn jiē xiàn , diào yīn , chàng wán yòu yào shōu yī biàn . tā kàn kàn kōng xià lái de zhuō zi , shuō nà suàn le , bāng wǒ bǎ yǐ zi bān guò qù . wǒ zài mén kǒu qīng qīng hēng le yī jù , lín ān bǎ zuì hòu yī xíng jiē shàng , dà jiā xiào le . gāng cái hái xiǎng zài chàng de rén yě gēn zhe hēng , méi yǒu huí qù kāi shè bèi . gōng zuò rén yuán ná lái zuì hòu yī bǎ yǐ zi , wèn wǒ men míng tiān shì bú shì hái qǐ de lái , wǒ men mǎ shàng bǎ mén ràng kāi , yī biān xiào yī biān wǎng wài zǒu .
lines.en: After 9:30 we shut down the equipment. Others gathered papers and coiled cables while I packed my instrument. Someone asked for one more minute of singing. I pointed to the disconnected cable: we'd have to reconnect, tune and pack again. Looking at the cleared table, he offered to carry chairs instead. At the door I hummed a phrase; Lin An joined the last line, and we laughed. Even the friend who'd wanted more singing hummed along without restarting anything. Carrying the final chair, a staff member asked if we'd manage to get up tomorrow. We moved out of the doorway, still laughing.

lines.text: 我原来把合作顺利理解成从来不会意见不同。后来一次讨论中，两个人意见很不同，却一起把任务写清楚，按约定完成。回看记录，我发现意见仍然不同，只是有人及时说明理由，也愿意承担自己的部分。现在我更注意能否继续把事做好，而不只看表面是不是一直和气。

lines.en: I used to equate successful cooperation with no disagreement. Two members later disagreed strongly yet clarified and completed their tasks. Their disagreement remained, but they explained reasons and took responsibility. I now attend to how work proceeds, not just surface harmony.
